tools.name: estimate_route_price
tools.description: Indicative price of a full truckload (FTL) between two places in Europe, from Vuz Transport (Polish road carrier). Distance is a rough estimate (straight line x 1.2) unless km is given. Returns total in EUR, a range, the rate per km and a link that opens the calculator and quote form already filled

tools.name: send_quote_request
tools.description: Sends a transport quote request to the Vuz Transport team by email, exactly like the form on the website. They reply to the customer within 2 working hours on working days. BEFORE calling: show the user every detail you will send (route, date, load, name, email, phone, message), tell them their cont

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "send_quote_request" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Sends a transport quote request to the Vuz Transport team by email, exactly like the form on the website. They reply to the customer within 2 working hours on w…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: send_quote_request · Private data: send_quote_request · Public sink: send_quote_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: send_quote_request · Private data: send_quote_request · Public sink: send_quote_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
